The tumbler was already refunded for BRL 39.90, receipt R-H255-0001. Each unit can be refunded only once (refund-policy/v2/remaining). The shop’s receipt records the refund in its test ledger, not as a bank transfer, and the shop doesn’t give a date for money to appear on a card (refund-policy/v2/payout).
